name: Miyamae Haruna
source:
The caring childhood friend.

She has a kind and cheerful personality towards everyone. She is especially attentive towards Seiichi. She feels a sense of gratitude towards him, because he helped her with her family issues when they were young. Her old nickname for Seiichi was "Sei-chan."
She belongs to the tennis club and respects her senior, Haruna Yuuma.

[Translated from [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc044/character.html]the official site[/url]]
